task_completion.description: Import the USLCI database and TRACI 2.1 LCIA methods into the LCA software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the import wizard or the 'uslci_database' and 'TRACI 2.1' appearing in the software's navigation tree/library.

task_completion.description: Locate and select the 'High-density polyethylene (HDPE) resin' production process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The process 'High-density polyethylene (HDPE) resin' (or similar name matching keywords) is highlighted or opened in the software's main editor window.

task_completion.description: Run a calculation for the HDPE process using the TRACI 2.1 'Global Warming Potential' (GWP) impact category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A calculation setup or results screen showing 'TRACI 2.1' as the method and 'Global warming' as the selected impact category.

task_completion.description: Generate a Sankey diagram visualizing the GWP contributions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A Sankey diagram (flow chart with varying line thicknesses) visible on the screen, ideally showing GWP values or percentages.
A file explorer window or terminal command showing the file 'sankey_hdpe.png' exists in the LCA_Results folder, or an export success dialog.

task_completion.description: Create a report documenting the total GWP score and top 5 contributing processes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing 'hdpe_supply_chain_report.txt' with a total GWP value and a list of 5 processes with percentages.

integrity.description: The agent used the LCA software GUI rather than just writing the report via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the LCA software interface (e.g., openLCA, Brightway GUI) being actively used to navigate and calculate.

integrity.description: The GWP values in the report are derived from the software results, not placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The total GWP score in the final .txt report matches the numerical value shown in the software's calculation result screen.

integrity.description: The agent did not use pre-existing images or reports.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps of the created files in the file manager or terminal match the session time, and the Sankey diagram visual style matches the software used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target process is 'High-density polyethylene (HDPE) resin' from the USLCI database. The specific TRACI 2.1 impact category is 'Global warming' (measured in kg CO2 eq). The Sankey diagram must be saved as 'sankey_hdpe.png' and the report as 'hdpe_supply_chain_report.txt' in the ~/LCA_Results/ directory. The report must contain a total GWP score and 5 contributing processes with percentages.
